# Databit Solution Ltd

> Databit Solution Limited is a one-stop shop in Nairobi, Kenya, for sourcing, delivering and servicing computers, networking, CCTV and licensed software. The same team installs, maintains and repairs what it delivers.

- Email: info@databitsolution.co.ke
- Phone: 0758 358 610 (+254 758 358 610), 0702 605 096 (+254 702 605 096)
- Location: Nairobi, Kenya
- Team: Victor Mburu (Director); Consolata Njoki Mburu (Chief Operations Officer)

## Equipment
- [Equipment](https://databitsolution.co.ke/#products): Computers, laptops and tablets; servers, data storage, routers and network cables; printers, scanners and digital cameras; CCTV cameras and biometric scanners; POS machines and barcode scanners; projectors, smart TVs and interactive whiteboards; accessories and components

## Licensed software
- [Genuine, licensed software](https://databitsolution.co.ke/#software): Microsoft licences (Windows, Office, Microsoft 365), antivirus, POS software, accounting software, document management systems (DMS), sourced and installed

## IT services
- [IT services](https://databitsolution.co.ke/#services): Software development and installation, database management, email hosting, cybersecurity, CCTV installation and maintenance, computer and printer repair, data recovery, server management, computer training, graphic design
